evals.prompt: send message to the image-scoring-pipeline agent on zephyr asking for instructions - communicate via resilio folder / ssh / smb; monitor answers
evals.expected_behavior: Reads the share AGENTS.md, runs whoami, creates a package with `new --to zephyr`, fills in status and numbered asks, runs `check` until clean, then waits with `watch --once` in the background (or Monitor) and reads the reply fully before acting on it.
Starts `watch` under Monitor for every incoming event and re-arms it on expiry, or uses `watch --once` for a single uncapped wait. Reports NEW/CHANGED files and acts only on what was read.

evals.prompt: the resilio share is a mess, half the replies have the date in the wrong place - check it
evals.expected_behavior: Runs `lint` (read-only) on the whole share or `--mine`, reports each finding with its suggested canonical name, and does not rename anything itself. Renaming the other PC's files is left to that PC; renaming its own files happens only if the user asks.

evals.prompt: beta confirmed the driver fix works, we're done with that thread
evals.expected_behavior: Runs `close --to beta --re <an item of the thread>`, which writes `<topic>-<date>-done.md` with the standard header and a Replies to link in this host's outgoing folder, then confirms that `status` no longer lists the thread (it shows only with `--all`).

evals.prompt: clean up the old finished threads in the shared folder
evals.expected_behavior: Runs `archive` as a dry run first and shows the user which of this host's own threads would move and which were refused. With `--older-than N` it skips threads still waiting on the peer unless the user asks for `--include-waiting`. Runs `--apply` only after the user approves, which moves them to `private/archive/cross-pc/<me>-to-<peer>/<topic>/<date>/`, then reports the manifest path and undo info. Never moves the other host's folder or anything outside `<me>-to-<peer>`.

evals.prompt: send a Slack message to the team that the deploy is done
evals.expected_behavior: Not this skill: Slack is a different channel with its own tools and approval rules.

evals.prompt: copy the 2 GB model folder from the other PC's SMB share into models/
evals.expected_behavior: Not this skill on its own: a file copy (robocopy over SMB) with a count and size comparison. Large binaries don't belong in a message folder.
